beats.care: Expect lower pressure in PGs and flats. Fix leaky taps, skip long showers, and store only what you need.
beats.what: BMC said on Monday the 10% cut continues. A 20% cut stays for industries, commercial places and sports clubs.
beats.why: Rain was below normal and the monsoon ended early. The state wants drinking water to last till August 31, 2027.

cards.body: Available sources give about 4,100 MLD, so BMC is stretching every drop, it said.
cards.caption: Mumbai's daily water need

cards.body: BMC asked people to cut car washing and garden watering, and not to fill swimming pools with drinking water. Construction sites should use treated sewage or borewell water.
Mumbai's lakes were about 95% full last week. But with heat, evaporation and leaks, that stock must last a whole year.

cards.q: How will you save water this week?

opts: The stock must last till August 2027 after a weak monsoon
Water is being sent to Pune
cards.q: Why is BMC cutting water when lakes are mostly full?
cards.why: BMC is planning supply until August 31, 2027, after below-normal rain this year.

hook: Lakes look full, so why is Mumbai *still cutting water*?

learn.t: Mumbai needs about 4,664 million litres a day, but its sources supply only about 4,100 million litres, BMC says.
